IN THE BEGINNING

 
Download Jewel Profile
 

Jewel Homes was founded in 1995 and today is one of Kerala’s best-known developers of new homes. The vision has been the same since the beginning: to be a dynamic and innovative company with a passionate commitment to provide superbly designed and built homes in excellent locations in Kerala. ‘Jewel Homes’ has undoubtedly become a byword for excellence.

The humble beginning that took off from "Jewel Plaza" a commercial project at Kaloor, Jewel Homes has grown in leaps and bounds.

The 28 years that elapsed since the inception of its first project, Jewel homes has become one of the most trusted names in home solutions across Kerala. Pursuing a strong corporate philosophy, it has been able to strive and steer ahead with a strong emphasis on safety, quality and commitment. Jewel Homes is the realization of a vision by Mr. P A Jihas, its Chairman and Managing Director.

Through the years into the realty sector, Jewel Homes has developed over 12,10,000 sq. ft. of living spaces and is in the course of developing an area of 8,27,000 sq. ft. To design a living space and to develop it beyond the expectations of customers has always been the driving force at Jewel Homes. Instilling this spirit into each project is done by an expert team of Engineers, management experts and skilled labourers along with the adoption of the most modern technologies and state of the art equipment’s.

The Company seeks to emphasis its presence in Kochi and Kottayam with 4 new launches. It is also in the process of establishing a name for itself in the green locales of Munnar by venturing into the hospitality sector. The works of a new hotel project with an area spanning 1,00,000 sq ft comprising of 46 rooms have begun at Pallivasal in Munnar. Two other residential projects are on the anvil amid the hill valleys of Munnar.

Being one of the leading real estate promoters & developers in Kerala, Jewel Homes constructs with a conscience. It signifies the epitome of luxury integrated with superior quality and understated grandeur. The spirit of creativity and perfection of the organization is reflected in its endeavours to achieve excellence, a quality perfected in serving the nation for the past two decades.

Jewel Homes is a company which reeks of innovation. From the architectural designs of the houses or condominiums to the conceptualisation of the gated communities and even the advertising and promotions, Jewel Homes has always been an innovator in the real estate industry in Kerala. Already famous for its superior quality, professionalism and on-time delivery, today Jewel Homes has gone to the next level through the creation of world-class commercial hubs and residential projects.

28 YEARS OF FINE LIVING

Over 28 years, the Company has built for itself an unshakable reputation for quality, efficiency, trust, meticulous planning, top quality amenities, superlative designs, timely completion, guaranteed possessions and handing over of projects. Today, Jewel Homes places amongst the most eminent real estate companies of Kerala.

While looking at our eventful past with pride, we endeavour to change our accomplishments, redefine our goals, and surpass excellence. Manned by highly qualified professionals and equipped with the latest technology, we aspire to continue the development and delivery of outstanding futuristic integrated townships of international standards. Counted amongst the most prestigious real estate companies in India, Jewel Homes, with its paramount vision, will lead Kerala to newer and greater heights in the field of ingenious construction and artistic infrastructure.

A PURSUIT OF EXCELLENCE

CORPORATE PHILOSOPHY

Jewel Homes has created a separate niche for itself in the Real Estate Industry as a credible, robust and forward-looking business entity. This has been possible through a resolute focus on the core values of the founder.

The Company gives foremost priority to the expectations of its customers. All corporate efforts revolve around the paradigm of client delight, which has helped the Company to accomplish a distinct identity in the minds of its customers.

Another serious attempt is to become financially robust by taking strategically planned risks and mounting expansion into various genres.

The well-being and felicity of staff are of utmost value to the Company. Taking employees interests in precedence ensures efficiency and dutiful discharge of the designated assignments.

Building healthy and lively competition within peer groups is another factor that underlines workforce dynamics in Jewel Homes. We value competition as more competition creates an urge to strive higher and perform beyond the ordinary.

VISION & MISSION

Vision

To be a dynamic and innovative company with a passionate commitment to provide superbly designed and built homes in excellent locations in Kerala.

Mission

To revolutionize industry practices and standards to set ourselves apart from the rest and create a satisfied customer base by providing complete value for money.

FOUNDER & CHAIRMAN

Excellence AT WORK

Mr. P. A. Jihas, Founder and Chairman of Jewel Homes began his professional career as an industrialist. An n entrepreneur, he has more than 22 years of experience in the field of Construction and Real Estate. It is after setting up Jewel Homes that Mr. P. A. Jihas involved himself completely into raising the standards of Real Estate sector in Kerala and has by his sheer grit and determination made Jewel Homes a trusted name in realty sector.

Today, under the inspiring leadership of him, Jewel Homes has made a well-known name that is renowned for its quality of constructions, on-time project delivery and well-engineered designs that have emerged as trendsetters in contemporary urban development and housing. Under his management, he has introduced International Quality Standard and Process in construction activities. He solely believes in Quality, Transparency and Innovation.

A WORD FROM THE CHAIRMAN

"Professional in our approach, entrepreneurial in our thinking and loyal in our relationships, Jewel Homes is all about mutual benefit. It's a family business run as a large, extended family.

In the early 1990s, the Kerala property market was finding its feet again and I was looking for a challenge. I decided to see if I could take advantage of the emerging opportunities. So Jewel Homes was born.

For more than 22 years, we have implemented – and will continue to implement – innovative new projects and solutions that enhance the returns and experience for all our customers. 33 projects down the lane, we still adhere to this commitment. The smile of our customers has always been priceless for us. It is to this target that we set our goals. Our team of experts and R & D specialists' ranging from engineers' management professionals, technicians and skilled laborers help us achieve this objective. By utilizing most modern technological knowhow and equipment’s, Jewel Homes has been able to deliver living spaces that are of superior technical quality and aesthetic appeal. Consequently, our patrons have always found the Jewel experience extremely fulfilling and trustworthy.

We are always happy to share our specialist property knowledge, which consistently proves to be of great benefit to investors in Kerala. Our aim is to exceed our own and our customers' expectations."

THE MANAGEMENT TEAM

Experience is a crucial element of our success. Jewel Homes is a professionally managed company with experienced professionals comprising of design, architecture, finance, engineering, legal, commercial, strategy, PR and corporate communication, sales & marketing, CRM & facility management departments that provide strategic direction focused on delivering results. With a commitment to Vision and Mission and the Values, they ensure high-integrity and continued credence in all we do and deliver.

THE ESSENCE OF QUALITY

Committed to delivering high quality, affordable residential properties across Kerala, Jewel Homes focuses on design excellence to achieve varied and sustainable long-term communities at each project sites.

We believe that successful regeneration projects are built with the local community and its future in mind. By investing in new facilities, housing, commercial spaces and amenities, we’re able to develop high-quality places to live and work that support local people and businesses, while improving the quality of life.

Through better design, careful material choices and intelligent waste consumption methods, Jewel Homes always give prime importance to manage the natural resources more carefully, and thereby reduce the environmental footprint to create cleaner and greener places. With each project we are involved in, we aim to improve people’s lives and their living environment.
